ImageDescription.value:
NASA Photo ID: STS001-12-322 File Name: 10060368.jpg

Film Type: 70mm Date Taken: 04/14/81 Title: Eleuthera Island, Bahamas

  • Description:
Eleuthera Island, (24.5N, 76.0W) Bahamas Island Group, is one of several within the archipelago bordered by shallow seas, visible here as light blue. Mosaic patterns of sand waves built by sea bottom currents in the shallows stand out in stark contrast to the deep blue of the ocean depths of a thousand feet in the Exuma Sound.
